findings.evidence: The declarations mention only `sphere`, `EuclideanSpace`, nonemptiness, and connectedness; their statements contain neither `Deck` nor quotient-covering notions, while `RealProjective/Basic.lean:65` already defines the same sphere as the domain of `mk`.
findings.fix: Move both declarations to `RealProjective/Basic.lean` and move the required `Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Module.Connected` import there; let `Deck.lean` obtain them through its `RealProjective.Basic` import.
findings.issue: `instNonemptySphere` and `connectedSpace_sphere` (line 70) are general facts about the sphere underlying real projective space, independent of deck transformations, so placing them in `RealProjective/Deck.lean` makes broadly useful foundational API depend on later deck theory.

summary: Two foundational sphere declarations are exposed from the deck-computation module instead of the earlier real-projective basic module.
